findings.detail: The success-path guard at line 223 correctly calls `setStatus(ProcessingStatus.IDLE)` before returning; the error-path guard at line 254 is a bare `return`. Status therefore stays PROCESSING, and nothing else ever clears it: the clear-on-config-change effect (line 136) only resets result state, not `status`, and the Run button is `disabled={status === ProcessingStatus.PROCESSING}` (line 489), so the user cannot start the follow-up run that would reset it. The result is the exact failure commit e0a2984 was written to fix — spinner at line 492 spinning forever, ProgressBar at line 498 frozen at 20, Run disabled, no message — only reachable through the error path instead of the happy one. Trigger is narrow: the config change must land inside the 100 ms `setTimeout` at line 201 (`buildLookup` is synchronous and blocks the main thread, so no interaction is possible during the compute), and the run must then throw. That narrowness is the only reason this is medium and not high; the consequence when it fires is unrecoverable short of the panel's Reset button.
findings.summary: Superseded-run guard in catch leaves the tab stuck in PROCESSING

findings.detail: Line 2 imports `{ useState, useEffect, useMemo }` and every other hook in the file is called unqualified; `runIdRef` is the only `React.*` call site. Functionally identical — purely a consistency observation, not a request.
findings.summary: `React.useRef` where the file imports hooks by name

findings.detail: Commit 0ac600d states "the panel is fully localised rather than nearly." That is true of `runLookup`, but `handleDownload` in the same file still emits English literals (`Batch Download Complete (…)`, `Download Complete.`, `Download Error: …`), as does the `Reset` button label. Those lines are outside this diff and I am not asking for a change to them here — flagging only because the commit message will be the record a future reader trusts, and it currently overstates the coverage. The rest of the message is a model of the WHY-not-WHAT shape the commit-message handbook asks for.
findings.summary: Commit message claims the panel is fully localised; three strings remain
